title: Nintendo Is Selling A Talking Flower
description: Have you ever wanted to own an officially licensed Nintendo talking flower? Soon you will be able to. After announcing the talking flower months ago, Nintendo has now shared more details about the Talking Flower inspired by Super Mario Bros. Wonder's upcoming Switch 2 edition. "Leave it to speak freely or press the button to make it talk immediately--press the button often and it might even say something special," Nintendo said. The flower can also serve as an alarm clock to help you wake up in the morning, or you can set a bedtime reminder and it will squawk at you to please go to bed. The flower also monitors the time of day and the temperature and "won't be shy about letting you know the details." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Sonic The Hedgehog Is Getting Scripted Noir Podcast Starring The Chaotix
description: This year marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog, but Sega's first Sonic project of 2026 isn't what anyone expected. Instead of revealing a new Sonic game, the official Sonic the Hedgehog YouTube page has shared a teaser trailer for a new noir-ish scripted podcast called Sonic Presents: The Chaotix Casefiles. While Sonic will have a leading role in the story, it appears that the Chaotix--Vector the Crocodile, Espio the Chameleon, and Charmy Bee--are taking the primary focus as "the intrepid Chaotix Detective Agency." That trio of heroes made their debut in Knuckles' Chaotix before returning in Sonic Heroes and forming their own detective agency. The description for the series doesn't offer many hints about the story itself, although Eggman is also confirmed to appear. According to the video, the Chaotix and Sonic will embark on a "high-flying, action-packed adventure [that] will take them across the world, fighting for every clue they can find. It's one heck of a tale. Which is good, because this story might be the only thing that can save their lives." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Game Union Calls For Strike Against Ubisoft Following Cancellations
description: Earlier in January, Ubisoft shut down Ubisoft Halifax and laid off 70 developers who had recently voted to unionize. But those aren't the only cuts ahead, as recently disclosed by Ubisoft. Six games have already been canceled--including the Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time remake--and Ubisoft CEO Yves Guillemot indicated that more layoffs will be coming. In response, the French video game union Solidaires Informatique has called for a half-day strike. In the social media post below, Solidaires Informatique set its strike date for January 22, and issued the following demands to Ubisoft's management. An end to the cost-reduction plan Maintenance and expansion of remote work conditions Decent pay raises for the coming year UBISOFT - Call for strike Following the disastrous announcements made by Mr. Yves Guillemot (cost-cutting plan, projects scrapped, end of remote working, etc.), the Solidaires Informatique union is calling for a strike on Thursday, January 22, in the morning.[image or embed] — Solidaires Informatique (@solinfonat.bsky.social) January 21, 2026 at 11:32 AM The union characterized its actions as a response to "the absurdity of management decisions," and didn't rule out further actions against Ubisoft. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Black Ops 7 Had Call Of Duty's Worst Sales Year Ranking In The US Since 2008
description: In the last two decades, there have only been a handful of years that the Call of Duty franchise didn't finish as the No. 1 best-selling video game in the US. Following the blockbuster performance of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 in 2024 wasn't going to be an easy feat for any game. But according to the domestic sales charts, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 not only failed to repeat its predecessor's success, but fell to No. 5 in the US for 2025. Circana has shared its US video game sales charts for December 2025 and the entire calendar year. According to that report, Black Ops 7 was the No. 1 best-selling game across all physical and digital platforms in December. That continued Call of Duty's seven-year streak of dominating the sales chart in December. The last time it was dethroned from its perch atop the final month of the year was when Super Smash Bros. Ultimate took No. 1 in December 2018. For 2025, Battlefield 6 was the top-selling game in the US across all platforms. Black Ops 7's performance in December raised it from 2025's No. 7 best-selling game in the US--as of November 2025--to a fifth-place finish for the year. Regardless, that is still the worst end-of-year ranking for a Call of Duty game in the US since Call of Duty: World at War finished at No. 7 in 2008. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Switch 2 Reached New Sales Heights In The US In 2025
description: Heading into 2025, it was widely expected that Nintendo Switch 2 would break sales records. Now that Circana has released its report on the US video game market in 2025, we have a better picture of just how well Switch 2 performed and how far ahead it is of its predecessor. According to Circana, Switch 2 led the domestic video game hardware market in both unit and dollar sales with 4.4 million consoles in its first seven months of release. That's 94% higher than the original Switch's sales numbers at the same point in its lifespan. When compared to Sony's PlayStation 4, Switch 2 is 35% ahead of PS4's sales in the same time period. A previous analysis by The Game Business noted that Switch 2's domestic sales plummeted 35% from November to December. Circana had also previously reported that November 2025 was the worst month for video game hardware sales in the US since 1995. That same month, Nintendo apologized for Switch 2 shortages that persisted for months. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder Switch 2 Edition Features Playable Rosalina, 17 New Minigames
description: Nintendo unveiled additional details about the Switch 2 upgrade for Super Mario Bros. Wonder, and it'll come with a playable character, boss levels, and new modes when it releases on March 26. The Meetup in Bellabel Park add-on includes 17 multiplayer minigames in an area called Attraction Plaza, and they support GameShare along with eight-player local wireless play and 12-player online multiplayer. Outside of these multiplayer offerings, the most noteworthy additions include Rosalina as a playable character and new story content in the main game starring the Koopalings. Rosalina will control the same as the other characters in the base game, but you can also select a Co-Star Luma character to play a support role. The Luma is invulnerable to damage and can defeat enemies and collect coins--you can even control it with the Joy-Con 2's mouse controls. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Beyond Good And Evil 2 Is Still In Development After Ubisoft's Purge - Report
description: Earlier this week, Ubisoft announced sweeping changes to the video game publisher, including the cancelation of six games. The only confirmed title from that group was the remake of Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time. However, a new report indicates that the long-gestating Beyond Good and Evil 2 was not among the games that were purged. According to Insider Gaming, "Beyond Good and Evil 2 is still in active development, at least for the time being." The original Beyond Good and Evil was released in 2003 and it wasn't immediately successful. The sequel didn't officially begin development until May 2008, and that's where it has stayed in the following 17 years. It's believed that Beyond Good and Evil 2's current incarnation has only been in development since 2017, which is still an exceedingly long time for game development. The title has been hit by some setbacks, including the retirement of the game's original director, Michel Ancel, who stepped away from Ubisoft in 2020. In 2023, Beyond Good and Evil 2's creative director, Emile Morel, died suddenly at only 40 years old. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Street Fighter 6 Unleashes Alex's Power Moves In New Gameplay Trailer
description: Until this year, Elena was the only character introduced in Street Fighter 3 to be playable in Street Fighter 6. However, Alex's turn is coming soon, and he's the subject of the latest Street Fighter 6 gameplay trailer from Capcom. AEW fans may have noticed that Alex has adopted some of his pro wrestling moves from Kenny Omega, who performed motion capture for the game. More specifically, Alex is unleashing the V-Trigger knee strike and the One-Winged Angel finishing maneuver. He also seems to favor getting close to his opponents before mercilessly beating them in front of the crowd. Alex is the third DLC character from Street Fighter 6 Year 3, following the release of Sagat and C. Viper in 2025. Last year, Omega starred in the reveal trailer for this group and he cosplayed as all four characters. Alex will make his Street Fighter 6 debut on March 17, while the final character, Ingrid, will be held back for summer. It's currently unknown if Capcom will have four additional DLC characters for Street Fighter 6's fourth year. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Animal Crossing Aquarium Tour Is Coming To The US This Year
description: Last year, Animal Crossing fans in Australia and New Zealand were able to experience an aquarium tour sponsored by Nintendo and Sea Life. Next month, that tour is finally coming to the US with stops across America through the rest of this year. Unlike the previous tour, there will be overlapping Animal Crossing events at multiple Sea Life aquariums. Each location will feature photo ops for fans to appear alongside Animal Crossing: New Horizons' characters in aquatic-themed backgrounds. Fans can also pose alongside standees of Animal Crossing characters, including Kapp'n. The tours will have educational material about the real-life sea creatures living in the aquariums. There will also be specific days where fans can collect Animal Crossing-themed stamps on a card or themed patches, as well as meet-and-greet photo ops with game characters Tom Nook or K.K. Slider. Continue Reading at GameSpot
